title: Heat-fusion joints.
officialText:
Joint surfaces shall be clean and free from moisture. All joint surfaces shall be cut, heated to melting
temperature and joined using tools specifically designed for the operation. Joints shall be undisturbed until cool. Joints sh all be
made in accordance with ASTM D 2657 and the manufacturer’s instructions.
